testcase.name: test_vod_momo_uses_transfer

failure.message: Failed: VOD /transfer migration incomplete: besoftAttempt=None status='failed' failureReason='Invalid request body'. /transfer endpoint hit in logs: True. This means BeSoft is rejecting our /public/payments/transfer payload — the 'transfer_collection' attempt marker is only set on the success branch of server.py:1495. If the response is 400 the failure branch (line 1485) does not set besoftAttempt, so the field stays None even though /transfer was called. Fix: (a) correct the /transfer payload shape (BeSoft expects nested Debit/Credit objects — see error 'Key: TransferRequest.Debit.Amount required'), OR (b) at minimum, also set besoftAttempt='transfer_collection' on the failure branch so migration is auditable.
